title.en: An Act Establishing A National High School in the Municipality of Arayat, Province of Pampanga, To Be Known As the Arayat National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor

title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia tại Thị trấn Arayat, Tỉnh Pampanga được biết đến với tên gọi Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia Arayat
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติในเทศบาล Arayat, จังหวัด Pampanga ให้เป็นที่รู้จักในชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติ Arayat
title.id: Undang-Undang mendirikan Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional di Kotamadya Arayat, Provinsi Pampanga dikenal sebagai Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional Arayat
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan di Perbandaran Arayat, Wilayah Pampanga dikenali sebagai Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan Arayat

text.en: There shall be established a national high school in the Municipality of Arayat, Province of Pampanga, to be known as the Arayat National High School.
The Secretary of Education, Culture and Sports shall issue and publish rules and regulations necessary for the effective implementation of this Act.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect within fifteen (15) days after its publication in Filipino and English in at least two (2) newspapers of general circulation.
